description: This file defines an interface for custom assertions related to Jsonifiable objects with selectors and predicates, used in testing the equality of JSON-related objects based on field selection and predicate filtering.

classes.name: JsonifiableWithSelectorAndPredicateAssert
classes.description: An interface that declares a method for asserting equality of Jsonifiable objects based on field selectors and predicates.

methods.name: hasEqualJson
methods.description: Asserts that the fields matched by the given field selector and predicate are equal between the actual and expected Jsonifiable objects.
